name: datacircle
description: Find the best GTM APIs. Datacircle benchmarks all the GTM APIs and puts the results on its website.

interface.longDescription: Datacircle benchmarks all the GTM APIs and puts the results on its website. The plugin adds Datacircle's open MCP server, which lists the APIs and searches their plans, and a skill that compares or prices a GTM API.
defaultPrompt: Use Datacircle to list the GTM APIs it benchmarks.
Use Datacircle to compare the plans of the best email finder APIs by price.
